notes:
FieldStitch 1.5.5 - faster feature detection on the graphics card:
- The descriptor step (about three quarters of the card's time per photo in 1.5.4) now runs as a dedicated GPU kernel, the way GPU versions of this detector normally do it. The card's results are still checked against the CPU before each job.
- Rendering on the graphics card is switched off again: in 1.5.4 it kept the card only about 10% busy and took workers away from the CPU, so the job was slower overall.
